classification.rationale: UTM adds a non-authorizing runtime evidence-aggregation capability and public machine contract, so engineering, regression, governance, controlled-evaluation, and independent-audit evidence are required.

evaluation.rationale: The claimed incremental benefit can be tested deterministically with representative bounded evidence packets without live provider/model execution.

controlled_evaluation.rationale: Permanent promotion requires a baseline-versus-UTM efficacy pilot rather than correctness tests alone.

engineering_validation.rationale: Canonical UTM implementation and focused fail-closed runtime tests require exact-head engineering evidence.

independent_audit.rationale: A separate read-only audit is warranted because the feature coordinates governance-adjacent readiness evidence across specialists.

evidence_refs: canonical post-merge cross-platform and Required Analysis PASS
regression_compatibility.rationale: UTM introduces runtime and public machine-contract surfaces that must preserve portability and compatibility.

security_governance.rationale: UTM changes readiness evidence semantics and must prove that readiness does not create protected-action authority.

independent_audit.rationale: The cross-specialist readiness contract is governance-adjacent and merits a read-only second-pass audit before a promotion recommendation.

qualification.rationale: Canonical engineering/regression/governance evidence, deterministic controlled efficacy evidence, and the read-only audit all pass for the frozen UTM candidate.
